# AppWorld pins pydantic<2, whose type inference does not build on Python 3.14, so this
# substrate needs its own Python 3.12 environment separate from the repository's. The
# distribution carries its own apps and task data, installed by `appworld install` and
# `appworld download data` rather than vendored here; the sealed data version is recorded
# in benchmarks/manifests/external-benchmarks.yaml.
appworld==0.1.3.post1
